notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Aqueous Aria using convoke without paying mana.
description:
Cast Aqueous Aria using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Campus Composer.
When Campus Composer enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
